desc:
Dig through the sand, create paths, and collect as many balls as possible! Can you guide them all to the finish? 🏆

⛏️ Dig your way through the sand!
🟠 Collect hundreds of colorful balls!
🧠 Create the perfect path to save every ball!
🚧 Avoid obstacles and tricky traps!
🌈 Complete satisfying and challenging levels!
🏆 Become the best ball collector!

💡 The more balls you collect, the better!

👍 Like the game for more updates!
